title: rewrite training loop with wandb

atoms.evidence: @dataclass class WandbResNetFinetuningArgs(ResNetFinetuningArgs): wandb_project, wandb_name — extends parent dataclass with wandb fields
WandbResNetFinetuner defines pre_training_setup, training_step, evaluate, train — the canonical 4-method lifecycle

class WandbResNetFinetuner(ResNetFinetuner): ... def pre_training_setup(self): super().pre_training_setup() — markdown: 'we don't need to rewrite our __init__ method, it'll be the same as for ResNetFinetuner'
wandb.log({'loss': loss.item()}, step=self.examples_seen) — must extract Python float for JSON serialization
wandb.log({'loss': loss.item()}, step=self.examples_seen) and wandb.log({'accuracy': accuracy}, step=self.examples_seen)
wandb.watch(self.model.out_layers[-1], log='all', log_freq=50) — markdown: 'be careful of the log_freq value - you want to make sure you're logging more than once per epoch'
wandb.finish() at the end of train()

self.examples_seen += imgs.shape[0]; wandb.log(..., step=self.examples_seen) — markdown: 'tracking self.examples_seen and passing this as the step argument ... easier to compare across different runs with e.g. different batch sizes'
logits = self.model(imgs); loss = F.cross_entropy(logits, labels); loss.backward(); self.optimizer.step(); self.optimizer.zero_grad() — the canonical 5-line body inside training_step
@t.inference_mode() decorator on evaluate; total_correct/total_samples accumulation pattern
self.model.train() in train(); self.model.eval() at top of evaluate()
imgs, labels = imgs.to(device), labels.to(device) — both in training_step and evaluate
